config.name: Latest AS path changes (12 hours behind, as RIPEstat publishes)
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT formatDateTime(seen - INTERVAL 12 HOUR, '%H:%i:%S') AS "RIS time (UTC)",
       prefix AS "Prefix",
       peer AS "Peer",
       arrayStringConcat(previous, ' ') AS "Previous path",
       arrayStringConcat(path, ' ') AS "New path"
FROM (
  SELECT _timestamp + INTERVAL 12 HOUR AS seen,
         toString(_json.attrs.target_prefix) AS prefix,
         concat(splitByChar('-', toString(_json.attrs.source_id))[2], ' (rrc', splitByChar('-', toString(_json.attrs.source_id))[1], ')') AS peer,
         dynamicElement(_json.attrs.path, 'Array(Nullable(Int64))') AS path,
         lagInFrame(path, 1, []) OVER (PARTITION BY prefix, peer ORDER BY toInt64(_json.seq) ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS previous
  FROM dfe.`bgp-updates`
  WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp + INTERVAL 12 HOUR) AND toString(_json.type) = 'A')
WHERE notEmpty(previous) AND previous != path
ORDER BY seen DESC
LIMIT 25

config.name: Path churn per prefix
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT prefix AS "Prefix",
       any(path[-1]) AS "Origin AS",
       uniqExact(path) AS "Distinct paths",
       countIf(notEmpty(previous) AND previous != path) AS "Path changes",
       uniqExact(peer) AS "Peers",
       min(length(path)) AS "Shortest path",
       max(length(path)) AS "Longest path"
FROM (
  SELECT toString(_json.attrs.target_prefix) AS prefix,
         toString(_json.attrs.source_id) AS peer,
         dynamicElement(_json.attrs.path, 'Array(Nullable(Int64))') AS path,
         lagInFrame(path, 1, []) OVER (PARTITION BY prefix, peer ORDER BY toInt64(_json.seq) ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS previous
  FROM dfe.`bgp-updates`
  WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp + INTERVAL 12 HOUR) AND toString(_json.type) = 'A')
GROUP BY prefix
ORDER BY "Path changes" DESC

config.name: Upstreams of each origin
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT prefix AS "Prefix",
       arrayFilter(hop -> hop != path[-1], path)[-1] AS "Upstream AS",
       count() AS "Announcements",
       round(100 * count() / sum(count()) OVER (PARTITION BY prefix), 1) AS "Share %"
FROM (
  SELECT toString(_json.attrs.target_prefix) AS prefix,
         dynamicElement(_json.attrs.path, 'Array(Nullable(Int64))') AS path
  FROM dfe.`bgp-updates`
  WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp + INTERVAL 12 HOUR) AND toString(_json.type) = 'A')
WHERE notEmpty(arrayFilter(hop -> hop != path[-1], path))
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 3 DESC
LIMIT 3 BY "Prefix"

config.name: AS path changes per minute
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT $__timeInterval(seen) AS ts,
       prefix,
       countIf(notEmpty(previous) AND previous != path) * 60 / $__interval_s AS "changes/min"
FROM (
  SELECT _timestamp + INTERVAL 12 HOUR AS seen,
         toString(_json.attrs.target_prefix) AS prefix,
         dynamicElement(_json.attrs.path, 'Array(Nullable(Int64))') AS path,
         lagInFrame(path, 1, []) OVER (PARTITION BY prefix, toString(_json.attrs.source_id) ORDER BY toInt64(_json.seq) ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS previous
  FROM dfe.`bgp-updates`
  WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp + INTERVAL 12 HOUR) AND toString(_json.type) = 'A')
GROUP BY ts, prefix
ORDER BY ts
